notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockisde Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Disappear by paying {2}{U}{U}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Disappear by paying {U}, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand.
Repeat.
